independent_preexisting_evidence.reason: C1 result evidence not canonically persisted

reason: The four reported survivors are confirmed synthetic fixture output, not public-data admission evidence. The later C2 preregistration already assigned C1 zero predecessor credit. V1 also violated next-bar semantics, repaired separately in PR1227. These facts close the old freeze demand; they do not establish an economic rejection of the mechanisms.
